title: Nazmus Salehin
text: I am an aspiring data scientist passionate about leveraging data, statistics, and machine learning to generate meaningful insights and solve complex societal problems. I aim to build predictive models and analytical tools that improve decision-making in social science and healthcare, and to develop methodologies that help detect and mitigate disinformation, bias, and harmful narratives in online news and social media ecosystems.
